selection: One unseen prompt per family, selected by the independent evaluator from a corpus unavailable to builders; no prompt may be a paraphrase of a development case.
freeze: The evaluator hashes prompt, input tree, checks, rubric version, environment facts, and arm order before either arm starts.
independence: A builder may not act as the live scorer or refuter for its own output.
claims: Report only results from executed cases; no sample supports universal quality, cost, or savings claims.
